entities.name: Dumitru Găleșanu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dumitru Găleșanu is a Romanian jurist and author, a postmodern writer, poet-philosopher, essayist, editor and book illustrator, known for his contributions to postmodern literature, and for his judicial activity in the Romanian justice system. He served as magistrate judge for more than 24 years within the Romanian courts of law.
